title: Model Mapping System
context: Cloudflare Workers AI model IDs use @cf/Provider/model format. ADR-006 implemented prefix-strip alias in GetByModel lookup. This is fragile: suffix variations (-it, -instruct) still cause mismatches, and users have no visibility into why metadata is missing or how to fix it. A user-managed mapping approach allows explicit declaration that one model is identical to another.

decisions.question: How should users resolve metadata for non-matching model names?
decisions.answer: Explicit model-to-model mapping table. Users create mappings via TUI or Web UI declaring that source model inherits target model's tags. Resolution uses live reference (redirects queries to target), not snapshot copy.

decisions.question: What happens to source model's own tags when mapped?
decisions.answer: Source tags are entirely hidden while mapped. The model presents only target tags. Unmapping restores source tags.

decisions.question: Where do mappings appear in UI?
decisions.answer: Dedicated Mappings tab in both TUI and Web UI showing all mappings as a table. Also inline in Raw model lists: action button to create mapping, badge showing current target.

alternatives.reason: Heuristic normalization is fragile, opaque, and doesn't scale to other providers like Ollama.
User wants live reference so target metadata changes propagate immediately to all mapped sources.

alternatives.description: Auto-discover matching canonical names via fuzzy match
alternatives.reason: Wrong matches possible, requires training data, opaque to users.

consequences: Users can manually resolve any model name mismatch, not just Cloudflare patterns
Mappings survive provider re-creation if model IDs stay stable
TUI and Web UI both need new views and model interactions
Extensible to other providers (Ollama, custom) without code changes
